limitations_and_boundaries: Whether other signals (e.g., GPCR, Mevalonate pathway, BMP/Smad, Frizzled) regulate YAP/TAZ in vivo remains unclear and requires further genetic analysis.
The mechanism by which Yorkie senses tissue damage remains unclear.
Whether GPCRs or PKA are truly physiologically involved in regulation of Yorkie or YAP/TAZ in vivo is unclear.
There is no evidence that regulation of Rho GTPase prenylation is a physiological mechanism of YAP/TAZ regulation in vivo.
Further work is needed to establish which RTKs are genetically required to regulate YAP/TAZ in different tissues.
